page.layout: One block of running text at the top, paragraphs set full width. Below it, a woodcut ornament (eagle or phoenix in a frame) centred, with the caption "TYPUS" to its lower right. Printed page number at the head, running title in the head line.

l.i: lubriter scienda nescio, doce me; in his qua vera no-
vi, custodi me; in quibus ut homo fallor, corrige me;
in quibus veris titubo, confirma me, & à falsis &
noxiis eripe me: benedic valetudini mea, ut mens sana
in corpore sano te reverenter agnoscat, & gloriosis-
Superest, ut Technologiam typo quodam adum-
brem, adeoq; methodi rationem, & si assequutus sum,

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (an eagle or phoenix on a flame and nest, within a frame of two grotesque figures and scrolls) is not text and is not transcribed. The caption "TYPUS" sits beside its lower right corner. The first paragraph is continued from the previous page and is set entirely in italic. The word "qua" is read as printed in "in his qua vera", not as "quae". The word "quacunq;" is taken from its line end, where it breaks as "quacunq; sa-". Some letters are soft in the scan, but the reading is reliable.
